text: U1: stand-alone PD sink; no NVM. ADC straps 3/5/1/0
15 V min/max, 1 A operating / 1.5 A maximum; I2C 0x21
PPHV can carry default 5 V: U2 lockout + firmware qualification required.
D1: 22 V VBUS flat clamp; surge margin requires qualification.
D2: CC-only 5.5 V ESD. Never connect D2 to VBUS.
J1 shield tied directly to local ground; USB data unused.
U3: 3.3 V / 150 mA control LDO, 30 V input rating.
EN floating = enabled. Intended control load <15 mA.
Power present does not mean motor ready.
U2: 2.7–23 V eFuse; 1.19 A nominal limit; latched faults.
UV ≈13.2 V / OV ≈16.8 V. 0.2 V/ms soft start.
Q2 defaults ON to inhibit power until a valid PD contract.
U4: TPS54202 buck, 15 V → 11.980 V nominal; 500 kHz.
Input 4.5–28 V; IC 2 A rating is not a board rating.
15 µH / 47 µF polymer; FB = 191 kΩ / 10 kΩ; EN internally pulled up.
U5: continuous reverse-current blocking isolates regenerated VM from the buck.
UV ≈10.872 V / OV ≈13.2 V; 1.19 A nominal limit. 470 µF bulk is downstream.
HEALTH combines open-drain ready/fault signals; U2 disable resets both power stages.
PMODE low = PH/EN; 20 kHz drive/brake PWM. EN low = brake.
nSLEEP low = high-impedance coast; firmware ramps before STOP.
IMODE floating = 25 µs fixed-off-time regulation, latched overcurrent fault.
Ilimit ≈2.5 V / (9.8795 kΩ × 450 µA/A) = 0.562 A; prototype setting.
J2: PA25-24126000-G23 ONLY; rated 12 V / 250 mA, two wires.
0.56 A regulation is not a continuous motor rating. Stall duration is unknown.
Firmware overload shutdown and board-temperature trip do not measure winding temperature.
C23: 470 µF / 25 V; rail clamp is on sheet 04. No external VM power injection.
U7: 2.5 V shunt reference, 0.2% initial accuracy.
Powered from VM so the clamp works after USB removal.
4.7 kΩ bias ≈2 mA at 12 V; also sets motor current limit.
U8: VM-powered dual open-collector comparator, 2–36 V.
A: hysteretic shunt, nominal ON 13.43 V / OFF ≈12.95 V.
B: NTC overtemperature directly inhibits the driver.
Thresholds and pulse-energy capacity require prototype verification.
R70–R77: 8 × 200 Ω / 2 W in parallel = 25 Ω, ±5%; ≈7.84 W total at 14 V.
Initial supervised-test envelope: ≤0.5 J/event, ≤1 W average; these are qualification targets.
R78: 10 kΩ NTC B25/50=3380 K. Hardware trip around 70°C; firmware trips earlier.
No continuous externally driven load. Safe reversal coast time must be measured.
U9: STM32C011F4P6, 3.3 V; internal oscillator; 16 KB flash / 6 KB RAM.
20 kHz PWM, input debounce, restart latch, ramp and overload timer.
I2C reads the active fixed 15 V contract; invalid contract disables U2.
Reset/watchdog: PWM and nSLEEP pulled low; U2 inhibited. No USB data.
U10: 3.3 V AND gate; MCU request AND hardware HEALTH.
HEALTH low asynchronously sends U6 to coast, independent of firmware.
U2/U5 ready + fault, U6 fault, U8 thermal outputs are open drain.
J5 tscircuit JST PH SWD pin order:
VTREF is sense-only; power board via USB-C.
Panel controls: J3 → 10 kΩ linear pot; J4 → maintained SPDT center-OFF switch.
STOP = both contacts open; both closed is a fault. Debounce in firmware.
Startup/reconnect requires STOP and knob below 2%, then a deliberate direction selection.
Open pot wiper pulls command to zero. Control cables ≤150 mm inside enclosure.
Blue: control power present. Green: armed/ready or running.
Red: latched fault; turn to STOP and set knob to zero.
Reversal requires ramp-down, coast and re-arming.
Open-loop duty control: speed depends on the mechanical load.
